title: [Packed columns + YSQL] Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:269) FATALs seen in toggling off and on with tserver restart and manual compaction

labels.name: qa_automation
labels.description: Bugs identified via itest-system, LST, Stress automation or causing automation failures

body: Jira Link: [DB-4279](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-4279) ### Description Tried in 2.16.0.0-b46. The testcase case was configured to run for 4 hours and this issue was seen after about 3 and half hours. Below is the FATAL log: ` F1116 18:11:46.422570 5951 tablet.cc:1406] T b253bb4c591c4b57b422d94bd359cb0f P cf99f07cac3a4b04b8fd4fb953cdf28a: Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:269): Cannot find packing for table: 000033e6000030008000000000004000, schema version: 15 ` Run: [run link](http://stress.dev.yugabyte.com/stress_test/0c8a6dab-c810-4e94-ac2c-f8c9cb42e621) fatal logs can be seen here: [http://stress.dev.yugabyte.com/files/get?name=bfba3ca8-f462-4665-94b0-a2e6f9f41ef0-yb-t[…].compute.internal.yugabyte.log.FATAL.20221116-181146.4144](http://stress.dev.yugabyte.com/files/get?name=bfba3ca8-f462-4665-94b0-a2e6f9f41ef0-yb-tserver.ip-172-151-19-135.us-west-2.compute.internal.yugabyte.log.FATAL.20221116-181146.4144) Here is steps sequence: Below is the indicated graph, where I have selected only time frame when issue was seen i.e. when FATALs were found. We can see. We are checking fatals and core in regular intervals (in each iteration). So, it might be anytime between 2 checks. We have tserver restart multiple times, compaction is done, disable packed row and did rolling restart as well. ![Screenshot 2022-11-17 at 12 35 20 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/109518123/202409637-f0bc20e9-a8c2-4055-8282-62f5f8a7a304.png) ![Screenshot 2022-11-17 at 12 33 08 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/109518123/202409649-41c01a9b-2f40-4939-a827-ce2d65c239b0.png) Workload is: ` java -jar /tmp/tests/artifacts/sample-app-tool/yb-sample-apps-1.8.23.jar --workload SqlDataLoadWithDDL --uuid be0bf2b2-9115-4ab4-995e-5b1224568587 --create_table_name test_packed_columns_sql_03ef29 --num_writes -1 --num_threads_write 20 --num_reads -1 --num_threads_read 20 --num_unique_keys 10000000000 --num_value_columns 100 --batch_size 10 --num_indexes 2 --use_unique_index true --ddl_operations DELETE_ROW,UPDATE_ROW,DELETE_ROWS,UPDATE_ROWS,ADD_COLUMN,DROP_COLUMN --uuid_marker 00186a7a-6e91-4690-acfc-ce14ff7eaadb --nodes 172.151.19.135:5433,172.151.16.85:5433,172.151.17.197:5433 ` All logs: Universe logs and Framework logs: [172.151.17.197.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/10029979/172.151.17.197.zip) [172.151.19.135.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/10029985/172.151.19.135.zip) [172.151.16.85.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/10029977/172.151.16.85.zip) [DB-4279]: https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-4279?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
